spec.name: ot_qkh_ktree_lkp-lkp1-52f03a544
spec.purpose: Per-lane KPV lockstep K-tree for the KV MU release die heads (OT_KV_KPV_LK=1 -> ot_qkh_head_native_r4_s_lk / _ft_s_lk): closed ot_qkh_ktree + all 16 lane kpv read, lane mismatch = lane fault on the existing g_f path. Replaces the KPV_LOCKSTEP unused-output classification (ROOT HOLD) by a hardware check. Static, +0 cycles.

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

spec.structural_change: KV-DCAL2 10-19 K.STA.ECTL KPV_LOCKSTEP (ROOT: no blanket lockstep admission, apply misc_b): ot_qkh_ktree_lk = the closed ot_qkh_ktree (ot_qkh_ktree_m5, same RTL + the m5 fastfp snapshot) wrapped so all 16 lane kpv are read: lane mismatch vs lane 0 -> lane fault into the existing gf_r -> g_f path (XOR16 + OR, 2 gate levels before an existing input flop). Same outline 151.2 x 97.2 (die slot unchanged), 15 new N-face pins (544 on 151.2 um = 3.6/um). +0 cycles, +0 flops. lkp: balanced full-face pins (lk1 gate showed PPL-clustered partial-face N pins ~7/um).
